lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: A standalone adult comedy episode in a Russian village: an old man's 'beast' Niva from a car flipper gets stuck in a puddle. Deadpan ironic narration. Last line — a confident, warm, clear advertising pitch for the bot «Перехват».

ego.profile: Egorych — an old Russian village grandpa in his 70s, slow, raspy, folksy, sly humor. He swears casually and naturally like an old villager — calm, not shouting. Adult comedy, uncensored.
ego.notes: Pronounce every swear word fully, clearly and naturally in the flow of speech — never bleep, soften or skip it. Line 1: confident. Line 2: stunned, slow. Line 3: tired, resigned. Line 4: dry. Line 5: quiet threat. Line 6: amazed, slow, delighted.

art.profile: Artyom — a young Russian grandson around 20, helpful, cheerful, a bit of a city guy.
art.notes: Line 1: helpful suggestion. Line 2: excited, proud.

mit.profile: Mityai — a rural Russian tractor driver in his 40s, rough, sarcastic, confident. He swears naturally in the flow of speech. Adult comedy, uncensored.
mit.notes: Pronounce every swear word fully and naturally — never bleep. Line 1: mocking, amazed. Line 2: proud, commanding.
